API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIRule LabelsRule Label Resource Get Rule Labels
Rule Label Resource Get Rule Labels
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/ruleLabels

Gets a list of rule labels. To learn more, see About Rule Labels.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 100, but the maximum size is 1000.

Default value: 250
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

The unique identifier for the rule label.

name
string

The rule label name.

description
string

The rule label description.

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the rule lable was last modified. This is a read-only field. Ignored by PUT and DELETE requests.

lastModifiedBy
object
createdBy
object
referencedRuleCount
int32

The number of rules that reference the label.

]
